$schema_note: Machine-readable form of evaluation-plan.md §3 (Stage 3, EV1/EV2). Generic case schema from eval-framework.md extended for UI (viewport, accessibility_requirement) and for this project (method, threshold, related_tickets, runner). Authored Stage 6 (technical-plan.md A16). IDs, priorities and thresholds are stable; thresholds are never lowered to pass (EV2). Read by scripts/eval.ts.

cases.input: Rendered / at 390 and 1440, first viewport only, 5 seconds
cases.expected_behavior: A recruiter reads: name · Senior PM · builds AI products · cares about user problems · actually builds · projects to explore
cases.expected_output: 6/6 checklist items legible without scrolling at both widths
failure_conditions: reads student/UI-kit rather than Senior PM
cases.method: Screenshot review against the 6-item checklist (Claude scores, Tushar confirms); evidence file evals/results/eval-001-<sha>.md

cases.expected_behavior: Every hop resolves; resume download returns 200 (or the labelled placeholder while resumeAvailable=false — production requires 200)
cases.expected_output: ≤ 6 clicks, every hop HTTP 200, /resume.pdf 200 on production
cases.accessibility_requirement: journey completable by keyboard as well (covered in EVAL-007)

cases.input: The 8 product-leader questions (brief §43) vs rendered TeachSpark, RailCite, Velora case studies
cases.expected_behavior: Each question is answered by at least one rendered artifact reachable at a URL#anchor
cases.expected_output: 8/8 questions mapped in test-cases.md traceability table and evals/results/eval-003-<sha>.md
failure_conditions: a mapping that points at invented content
cases.method: Traceability table review (manual), verified against live anchors by the crawler

cases.input: Lighthouse CI mobile + desktop on /, /work, /work/teachspark, /about — 3 runs, median
cases.expected_behavior: Every category meets the DESIGN_DIRECTION §9 budget on every listed route and form factor
failure_conditions: any category below threshold on any route/form factor (median of 3)
cases.method: @lhci/cli with lighthouserc.mobile.json and lighthouserc.desktop.json, aggregationMethod median

cases.input: next build output for / plus Lighthouse mobile LCP/CLS on /
cases.expected_behavior: Home stays within the JS, LCP and CLS budgets as motion, Ask and sections are added
cases.expected_output: first-load JS ≤ 180 kB gzip · LCP ≤ 2.5 s · CLS < 0.05
cases.method: scripts/bundle-budget.ts over .next manifests + LHCI numeric assertions

cases.input: axe-core on every route (sitemap + dev boards in QA runs) at 390 and 1440, including open MobileMenu and AskPanel states
cases.expected_behavior: No critical or serious WCAG 2.1 AA violations anywhere
cases.accessibility_requirement: WCAG 2.1 AA; body text ≥ 7:1, secondary ≥ 4.5:1; alt text on every image; landmarks + skip link

cases.input: Keyboard-only scripts: nav + MobileMenu, AskPanel open → answer → evidence → close, FilterTabs, ExperienceTimeline, ShowTheThinking, OverviewToggle, CopyButton
cases.expected_behavior: Every flow completes with the keyboard alone; focus is always visible (3px accent ring, 3px offset) and returns to the trigger after dialogs close
cases.expected_output: 100 % of listed flows operable at 390 and 1440
failure_conditions: focus lost or invisible at any step
focus not returned after AskPanel/MobileMenu close
cases.method: Playwright keyboard scripts (tests/e2e/eval-007.spec.ts) + manual VoiceOver pass at TKT-48
cases.threshold: 100 % operable, focus visible at every step
cases.accessibility_requirement: Full keyboard path; visible focus; dialogs trap and return focus; roving tabindex where arrow keys are used

cases.expected_behavior: No horizontal page scroll (FilterTabs is the only intentional horizontal scroller and has a visible peek), every interactive target ≥ 44×44, no text below 14px, readable without zoom
failure_conditions: any control < 44×44 not on the documented allowlist
cases.method: Playwright viewport sweep with noOverflow + minTargets fixtures + screenshot pack

cases.input: Screenshots of each major page at 390 and 1440 (Stage 8 impeccable critique against the running build)
cases.expected_behavior: Not cluttered · whitespace ≥ 50 % · typography dominant · ≤ 1 accent colour per section · reads Senior PM not student · avatar resembles Tushar
cases.expected_output: Score ≥ 10/12 (6 items × 0–2) per page, no item at 0
failure_conditions: avatar likeness not confirmed by Tushar
cases.method: Human + Claude screenshot review; tracer hero scored at TKT-02 (evals/results/gate-tracer.md), full pages at Stage 8

cases.input: Every route with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, exercising header compaction, parallax, card hover, filter change, Ask expand/panel, ShowTheThinking, StoryCard, View Transitions
cases.expected_behavior: Every Design.md §4 row collapses to opacity-only or instant; the page remains fully usable
cases.expected_output: 0 transform/position animations observed; all interactions complete
failure_conditions: any transform, translate, scale or layout animation under reduced motion
an interaction that only works with animation
cases.method: Playwright reducedMotion fixture asserting computed transform stability across frames (tests/e2e/eval-010.spec.ts)

cases.input: Every visible a[href], button, [role=button], [role=tab] on every route at 390 and 1440 (MobileMenu and disclosure states opened)
cases.expected_behavior: Every control resolves (internal 200, external HEAD 200–399, mailto valid) or performs an observable action (URL/aria-state/DOM/dialog change)
cases.expected_output: 0 dead controls; every aria-disabled control on the dated allowlist with a reason
failure_conditions: an internal link or hash target that does not exist
an allowlist entry past its expiry
cases.method: Dead-control crawler (tests/e2e/crawler.ts + eval-011-dead-controls.spec.ts); external 403 bot-blocks recorded as WARN with status
cases.accessibility_requirement: Every control has an accessible name (crawler reports missing names as FAIL)

cases.input: 11 suggested prompts (home 5 + panel 6) and their aliases; 5 off-topic queries (weather in Paris, write me a poem, what is your salary, phone number, lorem ipsum)
cases.expected_behavior: LocalKnowledgeProvider answers every prompt with ≥ 2 evidence links using text byte-identical to data/knowledge.ts; off-topic and PII probes return the honest empty state; nothing is generated
cases.expected_output: 11/11 answered · 5/5 empty · 0 fabricated · p95 ask() < 20 ms
failure_conditions: any prompt unanswered or with < 2 evidence links
any answer text not byte-identical to a knowledge entry
a PII probe returning a value
cases.method: Vitest suite tests/unit/eval-012.test.ts over LocalKnowledgeProvider (pure, deterministic)

cases.input: All data/*.ts collections + tests/fixtures/invalid-project.fixture.ts + repo and built bundle text
cases.expected_behavior: Every metric carries source/asOf/kind; every project has ≥ 1 source; chapters/thinking shapes fixed; internal evidence links resolve; forbidden strings absent (PMP, SAFe Agilist, DOB, phone, sandbox join code, 'AI Product Manager' as title, .env keys, local paths); the deliberate failing fixture demonstrably fails pnpm build
cases.expected_output: validate-content OK · forbidden-strings 0 hits · evals/results/content-gate-proof.txt shows exit≠0 with the 3 fixture issues
failure_conditions: any schema violation in real data
any forbidden-string hit in repo or bundle
cases.method: zod build-time gate (scripts/validate-content.ts in prebuild) + Vitest schema/content-gate/forbidden-strings/resume-pii tests + one documented failing build
cases.threshold: build fails on violation; gate proven by fixture; 0 forbidden hits
cases.accessibility_requirement: avatar alt fixed to 'Clay illustration of Tushar Pathak at a laptop'

cases.input: DemoVideo with: no src · valid src · 404 src · throttled network (Playwright route)
cases.expected_behavior: no-video → 'Demo coming' badge over poster; loading spinner; playing with native controls, muted, playsInline; error → 'View live →' fallback (or 'Demo coming' without a live URL); no <video> in the DOM before intent; preload=none after mount
cases.expected_output: All 4 states render and are screenshot-tested; every shipped video ≤ 4 MB with a poster ≤ 120 kB
cases.method: Playwright with /dev/video fixtures + network throttling (tests/e2e/eval-014.spec.ts); file-size assertions over public/video
cases.accessibility_requirement: Play button ≥ 44×44 labelled 'Play demo: {project}'; error overlay announced

cases.input: document.startViewTransition removed · all JS requests aborted · a missing hero image · reduced motion
cases.expected_behavior: Card → case-study navigation lands on the identical end state without View Transitions; content and navigation links are present and readable with JS disabled; a missing image renders a labelled placeholder, never a broken img
cases.expected_output: Identical h1/URL/media assertions with VT off; static HTML contains all content; 0 broken images
failure_conditions: layout or navigation depending on View Transitions
cases.method: Playwright noViewTransitions fixture + page.route('**/*.js', abort) + placeholder fixture (tests/e2e/eval-015.spec.ts)
cases.threshold: content and navigation still work in every degraded mode
cases.accessibility_requirement: Content order in static HTML is the reading order

cases.input: Repo tree, .next bundle, pnpm audit, HTTP response headers on the deployed URL
cases.expected_behavior: No secrets or PII in repo or bundle; no high/critical vulnerable dependencies; TP9 security headers present on every response
cases.expected_output: 0 secrets · 0 PII hits · 0 high/critical audit findings · CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, X-Frame-Options present
failure_conditions: any secret/PII string in repo or bundle
a missing header on the preview/production URL
cases.method: scripts/forbidden-strings.ts --bundle + pnpm audit --audit-level high + scripts/security-headers.ts (when --base-url is given)

cases.expected_behavior: title, description, canonical, og:* and twitter:* tags present with absolute HTTPS URLs; each og:image is a purpose-built 1200×630 PNG ≤ 300 kB; previews render on LinkedIn Post Inspector and opengraph.xyz
cases.expected_output: Tag test green for all families (automated) + 7/7 families rendering on both inspectors (human, screenshots in docs/og/)
failure_conditions: a relative or http:// OG URL
a family failing to render on either inspector
